name: Off-Highway Vehicle
description: A snowmobile, quad, recreational off-highway vehicle, trail bike such as a motocross motorcycle, or any other motorized vehicle built mainly for rough, unpaved or hard-to-reach terrain (véhicule hors route); an electric dirt bike like a Sur-Ron or Talaria ridden off-road is one. Power-assisted bicycles, electric mountain bikes included, that aren't mopeds or motorcycles are excluded.

restrictions.rule: Built or adapted mainly for uneven, unpaved or hard-to-reach terrain such as earth, sand, gravel, snow or woods; no limit on motor power
restrictions.citation: Act respecting off-highway vehicles, CQLR c V-1.3, s. 2

restrictions.rule: Must be registered with the SAAQ, with the off-highway vehicle contribution paid at registration
restrictions.citation: Act respecting off-highway vehicles, CQLR c V-1.3, ss. 10–12

restrictions.rule: The owner must carry civil liability insurance covering bodily injury and property damage
restrictions.citation: Act respecting off-highway vehicles, CQLR c V-1.3, s. 25

restrictions.rule: On a trail, road, public land or municipal land, the operator must be 16 or older with a driver's licence for that class of vehicle, and at 16 or 17 also a training certificate
restrictions.citation: Act respecting off-highway vehicles, CQLR c V-1.3, s. 16

restrictions.rule: Elsewhere, such as private land, a minor needs a parent's permission and must stay close to an adult allowed to ride, unless riding only on the family's own property
restrictions.citation: Act respecting off-highway vehicles, CQLR c V-1.3, s. 21

restrictions.rule: Every operator and passenger must wear a helmet with a visor, or safety glasses
restrictions.citation: Act respecting off-highway vehicles, CQLR c V-1.3, s. 52

restrictions.rule: May not be ridden faster than 50 km/h unless another law or regulation sets otherwise; signs can set a lower limit, and it's 30 km/h within 30 m of a dwelling
restrictions.citation: Act respecting off-highway vehicles, CQLR c V-1.3, s. 39

restrictions.rule: Needs a white headlight and red tail-light kept on, a brake able to stop it quickly, and a working speedometer
restrictions.citation: Act respecting off-highway vehicles, CQLR c V-1.3, ss. 58, 61, 65

restrictions.rule: Not allowed on a public highway except to cross at a marked crossing, travel up to 1 km where signs allow to reach a trail or services, or where a municipal by-law or the Minister allows it; never along an autoroute or limited-access highway
restrictions.citation: Act respecting off-highway vehicles, CQLR c V-1.3, s. 73

restrictions.rule: Not allowed on trails unsuited to it, such as hiking, mountain-bike or ski-touring trails
restrictions.citation: Act respecting off-highway vehicles, CQLR c V-1.3, s. 31

restrictions.rule: Repairs and modifications must keep it at least as safe as the manufacturer built it
restrictions.citation: Act respecting off-highway vehicles, CQLR c V-1.3, s. 67
